title: Check that a signal reached the agent
done: That is it: each request shows Sent, then Delivering or Delivered, then Answered.

steps.caption: Discuss lists your requests, and how far each has got.
Here a row of Now is sent to the agent to discuss.
Sent: the request is written. Delivering: it reaches the agent when its current step ends.

discussed.answer: The lint runs while the tests do, so that both finish together.

steps.caption: When the agent has answered, the receipt reads Answered, and the answer shows on the row.
Delivered means the agent was woken with it, not that it has read it yet.
Your turn: double-click a plan step to send another, and watch its receipt.
